You will also own the integration design connecting Oracle Fusion to Shopify for e-commerce order and inventory synchronization, and to the client'swarehouse management system(s) for outbound and inbound logistics â alongside integration with adjacent Oracle Fusion modules as applicable.

This is a nearshore delivery role, based in Mexico or Brazil, working in a remote-first model alongside Tessera's distributed FDE delivery and AI engineering teams. Because you will be running workshops and presenting directly tobusiness stakeholders and client leadership, excellent business English â spoken and written â is essential to this role.

Key Responsibilities

â¢ Lead and facilitate business process workshops with logistics, supply chain, procurement, and operations stakeholders to capture requirements for a greenfield Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation, spanning Inventory Management, Order Management, Indirect Procurement, and related logistics processes.

â¢ Own end-to-end functional configuration of Oracle Fusion modules â Inventory Management, Order

Management, and Procurement, with particular ownership of the Indirect Procurement value stream,

translating workshop outcomes into a working, standard-first system design.

Sportgeräte sind ein Wintergeschäft. Von Oktober bis März läuft bei uns richtig was, in dieser Zeit brauchen wir dich mit vollen 40 Stunden pro Woche. Im Sommer wird es spürbar ruhiger, dann sind auch 20 oder 30 Stunden möglich, ganz wie es zu deinem Leben passt. Du bist freundlich, hilfsbereit und geduldig, auch in stressigen Situationen.

Du liebst es, Probleme zu lösen und unseren Kunden den Tag zu retten.

Du arbeitest zuverlässig, eigenständig und hast Lust, dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Ein technisches Grundverständnis für unsere Sportgeräte wäre super.

title: (Senior / Principal / Lead) Headhunter für Start-Ups (m/w/d) - Berlin
description:
Warum A-LEVEL?

Du möchtest weiter beruflich wachsen und unmittelbar den Aufbau einer modernen Headhunting-Agentur mitgestalten? Du möchtest viel Verantwortung und zusammen mit dem Gründer & Head of Headhunting auf Augenhöhe eine Firma skalieren? Du möchtest, dass deine DNA direkt in die Kultur der Agentur einfließt und du das Team mit aufbaust?

Als Mid/Senior Headhunter bist du eine:r der ersten Personen in unserer einjährigen Headhunting Agentur. Du trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, dass unsere Headhunting-Projekte effizient und erfolgreich abgeschlossen werden. Gleichzeitig bist du eine Schlüsselperson für den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung unseres internen Talentmanagements.

A-LEVEL hat Proof of Concept und die Nachfrage ist stetig höher, als das was wir bedienen können. Für die weitere Skalierung brauchen wir dich! Hier hast du die Chance, unternehmerisch beim Aufbau der Agentur zu partizipieren - Sowohl mit der Verantwortung, die du trägst, als auch durch eine mögliche Unternehmensbeteiligung in der Zukunft. Des Weiteren hast du bei überdurchschnittlichem Einsatz auch die Chance auf eine Führungsposition.

Als Mid/Senior Headhunter supportest du den Head of dabei, dass unsere Kunden zufrieden sind, wir genügend Kandidaten platzieren und die Placementquoten steigen.

Was wir tun: A-LEVEL

Wir sind der Headhunting-Partner für Unternehmen in der Start-Up- und E-Commerce-Branche, der Unternehmen mit den besten Branchen-Talenten verstärkt. Mir mir (Maximilian Wolf) erwartet dich ein erfahrender Gründer, der bereits eine Agentur mit 40 Mitarbeitenden erfolgreich aufgebaut und verkauft hat.

Aufgaben

Wir sind als Headhunting-Agentur im E-Commerce in einer sehr guten Position, da die Nachfrage stetig höher ist als das, was wir umsetzen können. Durch den Verkauf meiner vorherigen Performance-Marketing-Agentur habe ich seit sieben Jahren ein sehr starkes Netzwerk im E-Commerce und im Online-Marketing aufgebaut, was für eine hohe Reputation sorgt und viel Rückenwind im Wachstum bringt.

90% unserer Mandate funktionieren mit Anzahlung vom Kunden. Ich als Gründer sehe mich dafür zuständig, neue Kunden an Bord zu holen und das Neukundengeschäft auszubauen.

Jetzt brauchen wir eine Person, die uns dabei hilft, Kandidaten zu platzieren, Kunden zufrieden zu stellen und unser internes ATS weiter auszubauen.

Deine Rollen & Aufgaben

Kand﻿idatensuccess(50%)

  • Sourcing und Erstansprache von Kandidaten über LinkedIN -> Verkauf von Jobs an Kandidaten
  • Sicherstellen, dass Kandidat:innen während des gesamten Prozesses gut aufgehoben sind.
  • Durchführung und Bewertung von Interviews, sowie Abstimmung auf Kundenbedürfnisse.
  • Vorbereitung von Jobangeboten und Verträgen in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden.
  • Vermittlung von Kandidat:innen, die für andere Rollen in Frage kommen, an unser Sales-Team.

Projektmanement von Headhunting Prozessen (40%)

  • Operative & strategische Verantwortung bzw. Unterstützung für den erfolgreichen Abschluss von Headhunting-Projekten -> Du bist mitverantwortlich dafür, dass wir aus bestehenden Mandaten Umsatz generieren
  • Direkte Kommunikation mit Kunden, Sicherstellung von Qualitätsstandards und Reporting
  • Du bist NICHT für die Akquise neue Mandate zuständig - Hier geht es primär nicht um eine 360° Headhunting-Rolle. Für das Akquirieren neuer Kunden ist das Marketing-Team und der Gründer verantwortlich.
  • Verhandlung von Angeboten und Verträgen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden

Produktentwicklung und Prozessoptimierung (10%)

  • Aufbau unseres internen Kandidaten-ATS-Systems -> Kontinuierlicher Ausbau unserer Kandidaten-Datenbank
  • Arbeiten an der Agentur zusammen mit mir als Gründer und dem Head of Headhunting

Qualifikation

Du bist eine Person, die sehr gut mit Menschen kann und sehr gut verkaufen kann.

  • Du verstehst den Unterschied zwischen Recruiting und Headhunting - Im Recruiting geht es einfach nur darum, Personen durchzuschleusen und die Qualität zu sichern. Im Headhunting geht es darum, Kandidaten zu platzieren und Umsatz zu generieren
  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung
  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Recruiting, idealerweise in einer ähnlichen Position.
  • Stark ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Recruiting-Plattformen wie LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.
  • Freude an der Arbeit mit Menschen, Empathie und ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative

Du in ein paar Sätzen?

Du bist ein:e Macher:in und hast Bock, unternehmerisch mitzuwirken und mit uns die Agentur zu skalieren. Du bist lösungsorientiert und setzt dich in die Gestalterrolle, statt dich in Ausreden zu flüchten. Du bist jederzeit umsatzorientiert und denkst mit uns darüber nach, wie wir den Umsatz und Gewinn der Agentur steigern können.

Darüber hinaus bist du Mitmenschen gegenüber wertschätzend. Ehrlichkeit und Respekt sind starke Werte von dir.

Benefits

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit einem erfahrenen Gründer und Geschäftsführer zusammen, der bereits erfolgreich eine Marketingagentur mit 40 Mitarbeiter*innen aufgebaut hat.
  • Du erlebst hautnah, wie ein Unternehmen von Anfang an aufgebaut wird
  • Du kannst unternehmerisch tätig sein bei uns und bekommst viel Raum für deine Ideen
  • Eine nachhaltige eine steile Lernkurve.
  • Remote-Hybrid-Kultur: Unser Büro ist in Hamburg, jedoch kannst du grundsätzlich von überall aus arbeiten.
  • Du kannst dir deine Arbeitszeiten flexibel einteilen.
  • Du bekommst ein neues Arbeits-MacBook
  • Attraktive Vergütung: 60.000 € bis 90.000€ Jahresgehalt, je nach Erfahrung. Wenn du einsatzbereit bist und richtig Lust hast, dich zu entwickeln, sind auch hohe sechsstellige Gehälter von über 100.000 € möglich. Du hast einen sehr großen Einfluss auf deinen Erfolg und dein Gehalt.
  • Chance auf eine Unternehmensbeteiligung in der Zukunft

Bist du bereit für deinen nächsten Karriereschritt?

Werde Teil von A-LEVEL und sei ein Teil davon, Headhunting im E-Commerce auf ein neues Level zu heben! Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Operations Manager
description:
OUR GREENERY is redefining how fresh, nutritious food is produced and consumed.

By combining innovative technology with a deep understanding of natural systems, we have developed the Raumgarten - a revolutionary solution that enables local, sustainable, and highly efficient food production. Circularity, efficiency, simplicity, and functional design are the foundation of everything we build.

We believe that sustainable nutrition is one of the defining challenges of our generation. Our mission is to make healthy, fresh food accessible everywhere while fundamentally transforming the economics and environmental impact of food production.

Since launching our first products, we have successfully proven the concept, built a talented team, and established strong market traction. We are now entering the next phase of growth.

To support this next stage, we are looking for an experienced, pragmatic and hands-on Operations Manager.

Tasks

You will play a key role in building and scaling our hardware production. You will be responsible for the interface between product development, manufacturing, suppliers, purchasing, quality, inventory and management.

Your goal is to transform our production from small-series manufacturing into a predictable, efficient and quality-controlled serial production setup. This role is not only about coordination, but also about industrialization, cost optimization, process development, supplier management and continuous improvement.

Your responsibilities include:

1. Strategic Management & Optimization

  • Operational leadership, with a focus on production and supplier management
  • Scaling our production from one to multiple locations
  • Ensuring high quality and targeting zero down time in our fleet
  • Setting up a near to perfect quality control system after production

2. Financial Planning & Management

  • Oversight of the financials including budgeting and controlling
  • Optimization of purchasing conditions and cost management
  • Ensuring financial stability while scaling
  • Setup of a clear KPI driven reporting

3. Support Customer Growth

  • Improvement of coordination and execution of our services for B2B clients
  • Building efficient processes to ensure the highest level of customer satisfaction

4. Team & Collaboration

  • Building and leading a high-performing team across all fields
  • Close collaboration with CEO & CTO to achieve strategic goals
  • Direct responsibility with decision-making authority at the highest level
  • You will work closely with the founding team and management, ensuring short communication paths and fast decision-making.

Requirements

What You Bring

  • You have done it before. Experience in operations (COO / Co-Founding a company are welcome) that scaled a business to at least 7-figure revenue
  • Experience with physical products and manufacturing them at scale
  • Strong expertise in cost management, and operational efficiency
  • A highly entrepreneurial mindset combined with a hands-on attitude
  • Ability to achieve ambitious goals with limited resources and lean teams
  • Passion for sustainable innovation and long-term commitment to the company’s vision
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to inspire and lead people
  • You know how to use various AI tools to increase productivity and strategy

You do not need to know all the answers on Day 1. But you need to know how to find the answers, how to build the system that creates the results we want.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • A core leadership role with significant responsibility and decision-making authority
  • An attractive salary and equity package
  • A modern working environment at the pulse of times
  • The opportunity to work on solving a real, meaningful problem
  • The chance to actively shape our vision and sustainably build a growing company
  • A culture of openness, creativity, and collaboration
  • A dynamic environment that enables fast decision-making and flexibility

If this sounds like you and we’ve sparked your curiosity, apply with your full application and let us know your earliest possible start date.

description:

  • So sieht Work-Life-Balance aus: 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Konstruktives Feedback wird gerne gesehen
  • Unsere Firmenkultur hat offene Türen & Ohren, coole Kolleg*innen und Spaß bei der Arbeit
  • Ein hochmotiviertes, leistungsfähiges Team, welches gemeinsam arbeitet - aber auch gerne gemeinsame Erfolge feiert.

  • Firmenhandy

Aufgaben

Welche Aufgaben hättest Du?

  • Leitung des Teams als Hauptansprechpartner für interne Talente.
  • Verantwortung für die Akquise neuer Kooperationspartner, Erstellung von Angeboten und Bearbeitung eingehender Anfragen.
  • Ausübung von Verhandlungsgeschick bei Vertragsabschlüssen und Preisverhandlungen mit Anbietern und Dienstleistern.
  • Entwicklung von Konzepten und Content-Formaten in Zusammenarbeit mit den Talenten sowie Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung.

Qualifikation

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Ausgeprägtes Interesse und feines Gespür für die aktuellsten Entwicklungen im digitalen Sektor sowie Verhalten der Konsumenten, insbesondere im Hinblick auf neue Trends und Technologien.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit allen gängigen Social Medien und Online-Communities
  • Erfahrung in der Umsetzung und/oder der Konzeption von Social Media und Influencer Marketing Kampagnen
  • Hohe Kreativität und Motivation, um innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln

title: (Senior) Strategic Partner Manager (m|w|d)
description:
idealo works with a broad range of partners across the e-commerce ecosystem – from international platforms and major online retailers to affiliate networks, agencies and technology partners. At the core of this role is the strategic management and development of relevant affiliate advertisers. You will grow existing business, identify new revenue and growth opportunities – including complementary solutions such as Retail Media – and build long-term, successful partnerships. In addition, you will further develop relationships with networks, agencies and other multipliers to unlock additional business opportunities. 

About your new role

  • You independently manage and develop your account portfolio, prioritising activities based on commercial potential and strategic relevance.

  • You build long-term relationships with your partners, understand their business models and translate their needs into concrete growth, monetisation and cross-selling opportunities.

  • You take ownership of revenue and profitability across your accounts and independently lead contract and commercial negotiations.

  • You manage your partnerships based on data and relevant KPIs such as GMV, conversion rate, CPO/CPC, approval and cancellation rates, deriving optimisation, scaling and negotiation strategies.

  • You identify additional growth opportunities, for example through Retail Media, assortment development or strategic projects, and implement them together with partners and internal experts.

  • You work closely with Product, Tech, Operations, Analytics, Retail Media and other Sales teams.

  • In addition, you develop partnerships with affiliate networks, agencies and technology partners to generate additional advertisers and scalable business opportunities.



Skills & Requirements

  • You take ownership and independently drive topics forward.

  • You have several years of relevant experience in Partner Management, Key Account Management or consultative sales and have already taken independent commercial ownership of relevant accounts. 

  • You have a strong understanding of e-commerce and performance marketing and can confidently use metrics such as CPO, CPC, CVR, cost-to-revenue ratio, revenue and margin to support commercial decisions. Experience in Affiliate Marketing or Retail Media is a plus. 

  • You can demonstrate with concrete examples how you have developed partner relationships and increased revenue, profitability or strategic value. 

  • You combine strong account management skills with analytical and commercial thinking and can convincingly engage partners around new solutions and opportunities. 

  • You communicate and negotiate confidently in both German and English and are comfortable working with stakeholders at different levels of seniority. 

  • You work independently, in a structured and results-oriented way, and are able to set clear priorities across multiple accounts and projects. 

  • Experience with CRM systems, particularly Salesforce, is a plus. 

At idealo you can expect

  • You want to further your education? We take your personal development goals seriously and, in addition to our idealo Learning Hub, eLearning offerings (e.g., Udemy), coaching & mediation, we also offer you the opportunity to benefit individually from additional learning and development budget.

  • And what about the office? title: System Engineer Linux-Infrastruktur & Virtualisierung (m/w/d)
description:
Standort: Remote (deutschlandweit) oder Hybrid – Office Bad Lippspringe, 10 Min. von Paderborn
Beschäftigungsart: Vollzeit, unbefristet
Start: ab sofort – wir warten nicht auf das nächste Quartal

Über reisewitz

reisewitz entwickelt seit 1984 intelligente Planungssoftware und ist europaweit für seine Kunden im Einsatz. Mit adelo® (Tourenplanung & Workforce Management), optaflow® (mobile Zählerkommunikation) und aures (automatische Disposition) steuern über 150 Kunden ihre Serviceteams – darunter Hardeck, BoConcept, Wiener Netze und zahlreiche Stadtwerke. Wir sind ISO 27001 zertifiziert und wurden 2024 mit dem Sust-Award für nachhaltige Routenplanung ausgezeichnet.

Unsere Software liefern wir nicht als Datenträger aus, sondern als Service — wir hosten sie selbst.

Deine Mission

Du betreust unser Hosting-Geschäft — als die Person, die diesen Bereich übernimmt, mit klar abgegrenztem Verantwortungsbereich und direktem Draht zum CIO. Die Plattform, auf der unsere Kunden täglich ihre Touren planen und ihre Monteure steuern, läuft auf Infrastruktur, die du verantwortest: eine wachsende Hetzner-VPS-Landschaft, unsere Virtualisierungsumgebungen samt Firewall sowie die dazugehörigen Netz-, Storage- und Backup-Schichten.

Dabei stehst du nicht vor einer fertigen Landschaft: Die Migration von VMware auf Proxmox VE ist beschlossen und startet gerade — du begleitest sie mit und übernimmst danach den operativen Betrieb des Clusters. Wie die Zielplattform im Detail aussieht (Storage, HA, Backup-Domäne, Automatisierung), prägst du fachlich mit.

Wenn du Lust darauf hast, wächst die Rolle mittelfristig um eine Beratungs-Komponente: Unterstützung unserer Kunden bei deren eigenen Proxmox- und Hosting-Vorhaben — Architektur, Migration, Schulung.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

Das erste halbe Jahr — Übernahme

  • Übernahme des laufenden Betriebs unserer Hetzner-VPS-Infrastruktur: Provisionierung, Patching, Härtung, Monitoring, Kostenkontrolle.

  • Belastbarer Überblick über Virtualisierung, Storage, Netz und Firewall — inklusive Dokumentation dessen, was heute nur in Köpfen existiert.

  • Ehrliche Bestandsaufnahme der Backup-Lage: Was ist wirklich wiederherstellbar? Der erste echte Restore-Test ist dein Projekt.

  • Erste Anlaufstelle für den Infrastrukturbetrieb — der Eskalationspfad läuft ab dann über dich, nicht mehr über den CIO.

Danach — Migration & Ausbau

  • Begleitung der VMware→Proxmox-Migration und nach Abschluss operative Verantwortung für den Cluster: Pflege, Updates, Storage- und Netzwerkkonfiguration.

  • Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der Umgebungen, in denen unsere SaaS-Plattform für über 150 Kunden läuft: Kapazitätsplanung, Performance, Verfügbarkeit.

  • Aufsetzen neuer Kundenumgebungen und deren Lifecycle — vom Onboarding bis zur Stilllegung.

  • Aufbau einer Infrastructure-as-Code-Basis (Terraform für Provisionierung, Ansible für Konfiguration) — weg von handgepflegten Servern, hin zu versionierten Umgebungen.

  • Aufbau einer ernsthaften Backup- und Restore-Disziplin: Konzepte, regelmäßige Restore-Tests, unveränderliche Backups, saubere Trennung der Backup-Domäne. Ransomware-Resilienz ist hier kein Buzzword, sondern Auftrag.

  • Härtung und Absicherung der Systeme im Rahmen unserer ISO-27001-Anforderungen; Pflege von Betriebshandbüchern, Runbooks und Notfall-Dokumentation.

  • Mitgestaltung unserer DevOps-Umgebung: Deployments, Container, Monitoring und Logging.

  • Mitbetreuung der bestehenden Windows-Server-Landschaft und Mitarbeit an deren schrittweiser Modernisierung.

  • Mitwirkung im 2nd-/3rd-Level-Support bei komplexen Server- und Applikationsthemen.

Perspektive (optional, wenn du Lust darauf hast)

  • Beratung unserer Kunden bei Planung und Architektur ihrer eigenen Proxmox- und Hosting-Umgebungen: HA- und Storage-Konzepte (Ceph, ZFS), Migrationen aus VMware oder Hyper-V, Konzeptpapiere und Schulungen.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Gehalt: 58.000 – 72.000 € brutto/Jahr, je nach Erfahrung und Tiefe — deine Einordnung besprechen wir offen und transparent im Bewerbungsgespräch.

  • Volle Verantwortung ab Tag eins und direkter Draht zum CIO. Kurze Wege, keine Eskalationsstufen, keine Gremien.

  • Echte Gestaltungsmöglichkeit: Du baust die Proxmox- und Hosting-Plattform mit auf, statt fertige Strukturen zu verwalten. Die Architektur-Entscheidungen der nächsten Jahre triffst du mit.

  • Voll remote oder hybrid mit Office in Bad Lippspringe — du entscheidest, was zu deinem Leben passt.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub, Gleitzeit, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und vermögenswirksame Leistungen.

  • Modernes Equipment deiner Wahl.

  • Begleite und gestalte die KI-Transformation unseres Unternehmens aktiv mit.

  • Weiterbildungsbudget und Zertifizierungen — inklusive Entwicklungspfad in eine Beratungsrolle.

  • Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Vertrag in einem etablierten Unternehmen (seit 1984), 25 Mitarbeitende, ausgezeichnet als familienfreundlicher Arbeitgeber im Kreis Paderborn.

  • Extras: Sportnavi (Firmenfitness), Corporate Benefits, Getränke im Büro, 1x pro Woche gemeinsames Mittagessen.

Klingt das nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung — Lebenslauf reicht, kein Anschreiben-Roman. Schreib uns nur zwei Dinge dazu:

  1. Welche Infrastruktur du zuletzt verantwortet hast.

  2. Ab wann du starten könntest.

Wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden und führen das Erstgespräch per Video — unkompliziert und ohne Assessment-Center.



Das brauchen wir wirklich:

  • Linux ist deine Heimat. Mehrjährige Erfahrung im produktiven Betrieb von Linux-Servern (Debian/Ubuntu) — Troubleshooting auf Systemebene, nicht nur Paketinstallation.

  • Erfahrung mit Virtualisierungs-Hypervisoren im produktiven Betrieb — welcher Anbieter, ist zweitrangig. Wichtig ist das Verständnis von Compute, Storage und Netz unter dem Hypervisor, nicht das Produktlabel.

  • Erfahrung im Betrieb von öffentlich erreichbarer Infrastruktur: Netz, Firewall, TLS, Reverse Proxy (Traefik/NGINX), DNS, Härtung.

  • Bash-Scripting sitzt, und du automatisierst mit Ansible.

  • Erfahrung mit Backup und Restore — und die Haltung, dass ein Backup erst zählt, wenn der Restore getestet ist.

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten. Du brauchst niemanden, der dir Aufgaben zuteilt, und erkennst selbst, was zuerst dran ist.

  • Du nutzt KI weit über Chatbots hinaus — als Werkzeug im täglichen Betrieb, im Scripting und in der Analyse.

  • Deutsch C1, Englisch B2.

  • Strukturierte Kommunikation: saubere Übergaben, verständliche Tickets, klare Statusberichte.

Schön wäre außerdem — aber kein Ausschlusskriterium:

  • Praxis mit Proxmox VE und/oder Proxmox Backup Server — der direkteste Hebel in unserer Migrationsphase.

  • Erfahrung mit VMware (besonders wertvoll für die Migration) oder Hyper-V.

  • Tiefe in einem Storage-Bereich: Ceph, ZFS oder SAN/NAS.

  • Infrastructure-as-Code mit Terraform (oder OpenTofu, Pulumi) im echten Einsatz.

  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-/VPS-Hostern wie Hetzner — inklusive Kostenkontrolle.

  • Cluster-Management und Hochverfügbarkeit, Performance-Optimierung, Kapazitätsplanung.

  • Erfahrung mit Docker / Containern, Kubernetes und CI/CD.

  • Erfahrung in einer gemischten Windows-/Linux-Landschaft (AD, PowerShell) — bei uns läuft beides.

  • Betrieb von Datenbanken (MS SQL, PostgreSQL) und Verständnis für API-/Web-Stacks.

  • Erfahrung in Beratung oder Schulung — der Hebel für die Beratungs-Perspektive.

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im IT-Bereich — wenn du es stattdessen praktisch gelernt hast, zählt das bei uns genauso.

title: Scientific Data Architect -Darmstadt or Düsseldorf, Germany
description:
About TetraScience

TetraScience is the Scientific Data and AI Company building Tetra OS, the operating system for scientific intelligence. We help the world’s leading life sciences firms turn fragmented scientific data into AI-native assets and scientific workflows that accelerate discovery, development, and manufacturing. TetraScience’s growing ecosystem of strategic partners includes NVIDIA, Databricks, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Snowflake, Google, and Microsoft.

In connection with your candidacy, you will be asked to carefully review “The Tetra Way,” authored by our CEO, Patrick Grady; it is impossible to overstate the importance of this document, and you should take it literally as you decide whether our mission, culture, and expectations are right for you.

Who You Are

You are a product-minded, outcome-obsessed driver of technical scientific solutions.

You a high velocity self-starter. You refuse to let uncertainty obstruct your path to designing and building solutions.

You roll up your sleeves, try things out, and get things done. You do not hesitate to prototype, demo, and build in order to accelerate delivery of products for your end users.

You thrive in environments where you can collaborate with scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform complex scientific data into actionable outcomes. Your ability to engage with scientists and business leaders alike makes you a key player in maximizing the value of scientific data.

With rich experience applying cutting edge data methodologies to the biopharma R&D domain, you bridge understanding between present-day pain points and generalizable solutions.

You are an insatiable learner, with a track record of deeply learning new tools, methods, and domains.

You fundamentally embody the principles of extreme ownership and have a demonstrated history of building extensible data models and applications for Biopharma end users to maximize value from their data via analysis and integration with AI/ML.

This role will require extreme self-discipline and determination as we forge a category that will fundamentally and forever change the life science industry.

What You Have Done

  • PhD with +4 years or Masters with +8 years of industry experience in life sciences  with extensive domain knowledge in drug discovery (target ID through lead optimization), preclinical development, CMC (all drug modalities), or product quality testing.
  • Proven track record of defining, designing, prototyping, and implementing productized AI/ML-driven use cases in cloud environments
  • Collaborated with cross-functional teams, including product managers, software engineers, and scientific stakeholders.
  • Performed extensive exploratory data analysis and workflow optimization to enable scientific outcomes not previously possible.
  • Engaged diverse audiences, from scientists to executive stakeholders using your excellent communication and storytelling abilities.
  • Advised scientists in a consulting capacity to further research, development, and quality testing outcomes.

Requirements

What You Will Do

  • You will be a critical team member in a unique partnership to industrialize Scientific AI. As such, you will engage directly with customers onsite a couple of days per week in the Frankfurt Region, building strong relationships, deeply understanding their scientific data challenges and requirements, and accelerating solutions.
  • Design and implement extensible, reusable data models that efficiently capture and organize scientific data for scientific use cases, ensuring scalability and future adaptability.
  • Translate scientific data workflows into robust solutions leveraging the Tetra Data Platform.
  • Own, scope, prototype, and implement solutions including:
    • Data model design (tabular & JSON)
    • Python-based parser development.
    • Lab software (e.g., ELN/LIMS) integration via APIs.
    • Data visualization and app development in Python (using app frameworks like Streamlit and plotting tools like holoviews and Plotly) 
    • Collaborate with Scientific Business Analysts (SBAs), customer scientists and applied AI engineers to develop and deploy models (ML, AI, mechanistic, statistical, hybrid)
    • Programmatically interrogating proprietary instrument output files.
  • Dynamically iterate with scientific end users and technical stakeholders to rapidly drive solution development and adoption through regular demos and meetings
  • Proactively communicate implementation progress and deliver demos to customer stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with the product team to build and prioritize our roadmap by understanding customers’ pain points within and outside Tetra Data Platform.
  • Rapidly learn new technologies (e.g., new AWS services or scientific analysis applications) to develop and troubleshoot use cases
  • Business proficiency of German required (C1 level)

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary and equity in a fast-growing company.
  • Supportive, team-oriented culture of continuous improvement.
  • Generous paid time off (PTO).
  • Flexible working arrangements - Remote work when not at Customer Sites

We are not currently providing visa sponsorship for this position.

Our Brand Activation department is where we move from product to culture. We do that through limited editions: co-branded drops with entertainment IPs, licensing deals with cultural icons, collaborations that make people genuinely excited about what they are eating.

  • Deal Negotiation & Contracting: You lead negotiations end-to-end and close with confidence. LOIs, licensing agreements, talent contracts, commercial terms, royalties, usage rights. You represent us in front of top-tier partners, agents, and IP holders and you get deals across the line.

  • Internal Alignment & Launch Enablement: You brief and align brand, social, ecom, and retail on launch strategy, content needs, and sell-in materials so every edition lands the way it should, in-store and online.

  • You bring 5+ years in licensing, brand partnerships, or co-branding, ideally within FMCG, consumer lifestyle, entertainment, or a licensing/talent agency.   • Track record managing both D2C and retail launches at the same time.
  • Degree in Marketing, Media & Communications Management, Business Administration, or similar, though your track record matters far more than the diploma.


AND WHY AHEAD?

Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together.

title: (Junior) Organisationsentwickler:in für Zusammenarbeit & Lernen (d/m/w)
description:
FÜR EIN NEUES GESELLSCHAFTLICHES ZUSAMMENWIRKEN: WERDE TEIL VON PROJECTTOGETHER

Die Probleme von heute lassen sich nicht mit den Methoden von gestern lösen. Deshalb bringt ProjectTogether Menschen aus Gesellschaft, Politik und Wirtschaft ins gemeinsame Handeln. Wir nennen das Collective Action. Als pragmatische Idealist:innen denken wir das Neue und arbeiten im Jetzt. 

In unseren Missionen zeigen wir, wie ein anderes Miteinander zu besseren Ergebnissen führt: von Einzellösungen zu Allianzen, von Fragmentierung zu Koordinierung, von Misstrauen zu Vertrauen und von Anspruchshaltung zu Mitgestaltung.

So bringen wir Hunderte Menschen aus verschiedenen Bereichen der Gesellschaft zusammen: von der Bürgermeisterin bis zum Aktivisten, von der Gründerin bis zum Staatssekretär, von der Familienunternehmerin bis zum regionalen Gestalter. Als gemeinnützige Organisation bauen wir breite Allianzen, die auf neue Art und Weise Lösungen entwickeln und umsetzen.


Deine Rolle in unserem Team

Als Teil unseres Kreises Human & Organisational Development (HOD) gestaltest und pflegst Du die Strukturen, Lernräume und Entwicklungsprozesse, die Menschen und Teams bei ProjectTogether dabei unterstützen, wirksam zu arbeiten und gemeinsam zu wachsen.

Dabei bewegst Du Dich innerhalb eines klar gesetzten Rahmens: rollen- und spannungsbasiertes Arbeiten, der integrative Entscheidungsprozess und gewaltfreie Kommunikation bilden das Fundament unserer Zusammenarbeit und Organisation.

Mit Deiner Arbeit sorgst Du dafür, dass wichtige Prozesse verlässlich laufen, Lernformate einen klaren roten Faden haben und Erkenntnisse nicht in einzelnen Meetings oder Dokumenten stecken bleiben. Gleichzeitig bist Du nah am Team und nimmst wahr, was gerade gebraucht wird: Wo entsteht eine Spannung? Was fehlt einem Team? Welcher Impuls sollte aufgegriffen werden? Und welches Format hilft wirklich weiter?


Verantwortlichkeiten und Aufgaben

Prinzipien unserer Zusammenarbeit: Du moderierst Rollen- und Spannungssessions sowie Retrospektiven. Darüber hinaus planst Du Trainings zu gewaltfreier Kommunikation und zur Übung von Entscheidungsprozessen.

Lernen und Kompetenzentwicklung: Du planst und koordinierst praxisnahe Trainings und Lernformate entlang unseres Kompetenzportfolios zu wechselnden Themen.

Lernkreise und deren Entwicklung: Du gestaltest teamübergreifende Lernformen, trainierst und begleitest andere Team- und Projektmanager:innen und stärkst sie als aktive Peer Group.

Teamformate und Entwicklungsprozesse: Du koordinierst und entwickelst interne Formate wie Teamtage, All-Hands-Moderation und Teamumfragen sowie On- und Offboarding und unseren organisationsweiten Weiterentwicklungsprozess (Entfaltung) weiter. Außerdem sorgst Du für eine verlässliche Durchführung und Auswertung.

Organisationsentwicklung und Zusammenarbeit: Du nimmst Bedürfnisse, Dynamiken und Spannungen in der Organisation wahr, greifst neue interne und externe Impulse auf und leitest gemeinsam mit den Leads des HOD-Kreises passende Veränderungen für unsere Zusammenarbeit, Prozesse und Formate ab.

Wissensmanagement: Du sorgst dafür, dass Vorlagen, Prozesswissen, Lernerfahrungen und Entscheidungen verständlich dokumentiert, leicht auffindbar und für die tägliche Arbeit tatsächlich nutzbar sind – in Notion und in Lernformaten.


Dein Profil

Wir suchen eine Person, die verlässliche Struktur mit einem guten Gespür für Menschen und Organisationen verbindet. Auch wenn Du nicht alle Kriterien erfüllst, möchten wir Dich ausdrücklich ermutigen, Dich zu bewerben.

  • Du hast mindestens drei Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Team- oder Projektmanagement, in der Organisationsentwicklung, im Bereich Learning & Development, in der Personalentwicklung, in der agilen Organisationsgestaltung oder in einem vergleichbaren Feld.

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrungen in der systemischen Organisationsentwicklung, im systemischen oder integralen Coaching, in der Mediation oder in der gewaltfreien Kommunikation gesammelt. Diese Erfahrungen können aus einer Ausbildung, beruflichen Praxis oder eigenständigem Lernen stammen.

  • Du kannst komplexe und parallel laufende Prozesse strukturieren, priorisieren und zuverlässig bis zum Abschluss begleiten.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Moderation interaktiver Workshops, Trainings, Retrospektiven oder anderer Teamentwicklungsformate.

  • Du verstehst Gruppen- und Organisationsdynamiken und nimmst wahr, was im Raum ausgesprochen wird – und was noch keine Worte gefunden hat.

  • Du arbeitest gern nah an Teams und bist bereit, regelmäßig vor Ort präsent und ansprechbar zu sein.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, bringst Themen proaktiv ein und weißt zugleich, wann Abstimmung und gemeinsames Entscheiden wichtig sind.

  • Du kannst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenbringen und bleibst auch in Spannungen ruhig, verbindlich und handlungsorientiert.

  • Digitale Werkzeuge wie Notion, Slack, Personio, HubSpot oder vergleichbare Systeme sind Dir vertraut – oder Du hast Lust, Dich schnell in sie einzuarbeiten.

  • Du lebst im Großraum Berlin und bist regelmäßig in unserem Büro in der Nähe vom Alexanderplatz vor Ort.


Was wir Dir bieten


  • Die Möglichkeit, die Lern- und Zusammenarbeitskultur einer Organisation mit gesellschaftlichem Anspruch aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Eine vielseitige Rolle mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum an der Schnittstelle von Menschen, Teams, Lernen und Organisation

  • Ein Jahresgehalt zwischen 50.500 und 58.000 € brutto auf Vollzeitbasis, abhängig von Deiner relevanten Erfahrung und Deinen Kompetenzen

  • 30 Urlaubstage sowie eine organisationsweite Pause zwischen Weihnachten und Silvester

  • Die Möglichkeit, mobil zu arbeiten, sowie einladende, moderne Büroräume im ProjectTogether Community Space in Berlin-Mitte

  • Finanzielle Unterstützung bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge sowie einen Zuschuss zu einer Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft, zum JobRad, zu einem zusätzlichen Lernbudget oder zum Deutschlandticket

  • Eine Mitgliedschaft bei nilo.health

  • 2.000 € brutto pro Jahr zusätzlich für Menschen, die direkte Sorgearbeit leisten - etwa Kinder

  • Die Stelle ist auch in Teilzeit mit einem Umfang von mindestens 80 % möglich


So geht es weiter

Du möchtest Teil von ProjectTogether werden? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deinen Lebenslauf und Dein persönliches Anschreiben. 

Die perfekte Bewerberin oder den perfekten Bewerber gibt es nicht – wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung, auch wenn Du die Ansprüche noch nicht zu 100 % erfüllst, aber die Motivation mitbringst, Dir die nötigen Fähigkeiten anzueignen.

Wir freuen uns besonders auf Bewerber:innen verschiedenster Hintergründe. Bei uns sind alle willkommen – unabhängig von Geschlechtsidentität, Religion, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Migrationsgeschichte, Alter, Einschränkungen oder Behinderung.

Auch wir nutzen zunehmend KI - freuen uns aber über persönliche, authentische und nicht-generische Anschreiben. Beantworte bitte als Teil Deines Anschreibens die folgende Frage in 200 Wörtern oder weniger:

Was war ein spannender Veränderungsprozess, an dem Du als Teil einer Gruppe oder eines Teams mitgewirkt hast? Welche Rolle hattest Du darin?

Der geplante Einstieg ist im Oktober oder November 2026.

Bewerbungsschluss ist der Sonntag, 6. September 2026.

We aren’t looking for a standard software sales rep; we are looking for a New Business Account Executive who understands the fabric of the German financial ecosystem. You will be employee number one on the ground, tasked with unlocking high-value segments: PE/VC funds, holding companies (Soparfis), family offices, and corporate service providers.
If you have the network to navigate corporate Germany, understand structured finance/treasury needs, and want the autonomy to build a market from scratch, this role is for you.


Your Mission

  • Originate Institutional Pipeline: Identify and engage decision-makers across Germanys unique B2B landscape, focusing on PE/VC funds, corporate holding structures, asset managers, and corporates.

  • 5+ years of B2B/Institutional sales experience within the German financial ecosystem (e.g., Private Banking, Corporate Banking, Fund Services, FinTech, or Treasury/Asset Management).

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: You thrive in an "AI-first," high-autonomy environment where the playbook is yours to write.
  • Languages: Full professional fluency in English and German is required. 


Why Join Vivid?

  • Hybrid or remote way of work. You can work from our Berlin office or fully remote from other locations.

Compensation range

Total target compensation: from €120,000 gross annually (base salary + performance-related bonus). Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

As a Senior Forward Deployed Scientist in our Supply Chain & Retail business, you’ll work directly with some of the world’s biggest retailers and manufacturers on hard, high-stakes problems: demand forecasting, price and promotion optimisation, and supply-chain decisioning.   • Apply and adapt frontier ML, forecasting, and optimisation techniques — and increasingly agentic AI — to problems that don’t have a textbook answer.

  • Turn what works on the ground into product direction, so each engagement makes our core capability better for the next customer.

  • Operate with genuine autonomy across a wide range of stakeholders — from data scientists to customer executives — and make the judgment calls that get things shipped.

  • Stay at the edge of what’s possible in applied AI, and bring it back to the team.

What you'll bring to the team

  • Strong track record applying ML / data science to real-world commercial problems, ideally with depth in forecasting, optimisation, or supply-chain / pricing.

Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Camunda's Revenue Operations organization is looking for a Senior GTM Systems AI and Automation Engineer to design, build and operate the AI-powered infrastructure that connects our go-to-market systems and removes manual work across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships and Account Development. You will join the GTM Systems team – a small group of builders who own a Salesforce-centric revenue stack – and take ownership of its AI and automation layer: agents, LLM integrations, MCP servers, retrieval pipelines, backend services and workflow orchestration. You will partner with GTM leaders to find high-impact problems, scope them, and ship reliable, well-governed solutions iteratively. This is a fully remote role and can be based anywhere we are eligible to hire.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build and operate AI agents, LLM integrations and automations that connect Salesforce, Gainsight, Slack, Salesloft, Clari, HubSpot, Impartner and the rest of the GTM stack – reducing manual work across Sales, CS, Marketing, Partners and ADR teams.

  • Own the architecture of the GTM Systems AI layer: MCP servers, APIs, retrieval and context pipelines, reusable agent tools and skills, and serverless or containerized services on Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions).

  • Ship production-grade LLM capabilities – prompt engineering, RAG, function calling, structured outputs, automated evaluations – with the guardrails to match: validation, fallback logic, confidence thresholds, human escalation paths, access controls, audit logging, and cost and latency management.

  • Partner with Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships and SDR/ADR leaders to identify and prioritize automation opportunities, translate ambiguous requirements into maintainable solutions, and deliver incrementally with clear documentation.

  • Raise the engineering bar for the GTM Systems team: code review, automated testing, CI/CD, security governance, observability and technical documentation; mentor teammates on responsible AI-assisted development.

  • Design and deploy workflows on orchestration platforms such as Camunda and Clay, and create playbooks and enablement so GTM teams can use and operate automations independently.

What You Will Bring to the Role:

Must Haves:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience (backend development, systems integration, data or analytics engineering, or automation), including at least 2 years shipping LLM or AI capabilities into production business workflows or internal tools.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js), with mature Git-based development habits: code review, automated testing, CI/CD.

  • Hands-on command of LLM patterns – prompt engineering, RAG, function/tool calling, structured outputs, model evaluation – and of their failure modes and mitigations (validation, fallback logic, confidence thresholds, human review, cost and latency control).

  • Experience integrating with Salesforce (REST/Bulk/Streaming APIs, data model, platform limits; Apex or Flow a plus) and other business systems via APIs and event-driven patterns, and with a cloud platform (GCP preferred: BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, IAM).

  • Ability to own a problem end-to-end with minimal guidance – scope, design, deliver, operate – and to communicate clearly with engineering and business stakeholders in a remote, asynchronous environment.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar standards for connecting AI systems to tools and data; agent frameworks; vector databases or retrieval pipelines (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB).

  • Exposure to AI observability and evaluation tooling (LangSmith, Weights & Biases, or custom eval frameworks).

  • Familiarity with orchestration platforms such as Camunda or Clay, and prior work in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Operations or Marketing Operations in B2B SaaS.

  • Building lightweight interfaces for AI tools (React, Slack Block Kit, dashboards); Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Integration Architect).

title: Senior sustainability advisor (engagement manager - jr. partner level)
description:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We are looking for an experienced sustainability professional to join our growing Sustainability Advisory team. The team serves as a strategic advisor to Watershed's customers, including more than 20% of the Fortune 500, helping them advance their corporate sustainability programs.

Our primary areas of focus include:

  • Decarbonization planning and execution across Scopes 1-3

  • Climate target setting, (e.g., SBTi-aligned targets)

  • Voluntary and regulatory disclosures, (e.g., CSRD, UK SRS, CDP)

Beyond customer engagements, the Sustainability Advisory team serves as a trusted internal source of expertise. We partner with the Product team to bring sustainability intelligence into the Watershed platform, and with the Go-to-Market team to strengthen Watershed’s expertise, differentiation, and thought leadership.

In this role, you’ll be a highly trusted advisor to sustainability leaders at some of the world’s largest and most consequential companies. You’ll help shape sustainability strategies that make business sense, create the foundation for bold action, and advance progress on complex climate and environmental challenges. You’ll also help build the market-leading corporate sustainability platform by supporting teams across Watershed.

This role is intended for candidates with experience at the Senior Manager or Engagement Manager level, or above, at a leading consulting firm. The scope, autonomy, business acumen, and sustainability expertise required are comparable to those expected at that level or above.

You will

  • Advise sustainability leaders at many of the world’s leading companies on advancing their sustainability programs. You’ll independently lead strategic engagements across target setting, decarbonization, environmental impact management, and voluntary and regulatory reporting. Working closely with customers, you’ll develop practical strategies and build the business case for sustainability throughout their journey.

  • Build sustainability intelligence by staying ahead of emerging frameworks, regulations, and market developments. You’ll translate the latest sustainability trends and regulatory changes into clear, actionable guidance for customers and internal teams, helping them remain compliant, competitive, and prepared for what’s next.

  • Help develop new products and services by exploring emerging sustainability needs across topics and industries. You’ll prototype new ways to create value for customers and expand Watershed’s impact at the intersection of sustainability, advisory, and technology.

  • Shape Watershed’s expertise and point of view by contributing to thought leadership, customer-facing materials, and internal enablement. You’ll help establish Watershed as a trusted partner for companies navigating the future of corporate sustainability.

What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years of professional experience, including at least 4 years at a consulting firm in client-facing roles and at least 4 years working in sustainability.

  • Deep expertise in corporate decarbonization and familiarity with key climate frameworks, including the GHG Protocol, PCAF, SBTi, ISO standards, and relevant reporting frameworks and regulations such as CSRD, LSRS, CCDAA, ASRS, ISSB, and CDP.

  • The ability to think clearly about complex problems and work confidently with data. You are systematic, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. You can present complex analyses and recommendations to C-suite audiences and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • A track record of driving strategic initiatives in complex organizations. You can influence decision-making while managing multiple internal and external stakeholders across organizational levels.

  • A strong interest in solving climate change and enthusiasm for helping define the future of corporate sustainability at a high-growth company.

Nice to have

  • Fluency in multiple languages, such as English, Spanish, French, or German.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling
description:
Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling

Hybrid in London or remote in the UK

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Credit Risk Modelling team.

You'll shape how iwoca models credit risk – setting the technical direction on multi-quarter projects, and lifting the bar for the team as you go.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Credit Risk Modelling team owns credit risk and Customer Lifetime Value (CLtV) modelling for iwoca's UK and German lending. That covers the probabilistic machine learning models behind every credit decision, plus the CLtV models that shape pricing and portfolio strategy.

The team is around twelve data scientists. Some work on auto-space models that decide within five minutes from data candidates authorise us to pull. Others work on manual-space models that pick up when a credit analyst adds digital footprint and income data, which lands a decision within 24 hours.

The role

You'll own credit and CLtV modelling projects end to end, from spotting where the modelling stack is holding the business back through to landing the change. The work spans keeping production models healthy, incremental development, and research that reshapes how the models work. AI has lowered the cost of prototyping enough that ideas which used to sit below the priority line are now viable, so the R&D share of the role is growing.

Live examples of the work:

  • Unifying auto and manual models. The two families were built without forced technical alignment. Finding a principled way to unify them on a common cost function is open work.

  • IFRS accounting model. A multi-stage credit model where information propagates back from later-stage recovery predictions to sharpen upfront loss estimates.

  • Generalising credit and CLtV. Whether a more general framing could replace both separate models is an open research question.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns.

  • Production ML. You have built and shipped supervised ML models end to end – exploration, training, deployment, monitoring.

  • Research mindset. You proactively explore new ways to add value. R&D time is when you expect to find the next step change.

  • Judgement. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right. You defend your reasoning under challenge, and challenge others' when the evidence points elsewhere. You've influenced technical direction beyond your own projects.

  • Project leadership. You've owned modelling projects end to end, from spotting the opportunity through framing, method choice, shipping, and landing the commercial impact. You move fast, iterate, and update on new evidence rather than chase perfection.

  • AI fluency. You use AI as a primary tool. You prototype with it, automate with it, and take on R&D that would not otherwise be viable. You use judgement on where it helps and where it doesn't.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Domain experience. You have worked in credit risk, lending, or customer lifetime value modelling.

  • Non-linear methods. You have shipped gradient boosting or neural networks on tabular data in production.

  • Bayesian methods. You have used hierarchical models, MCMC, or Bayesian updating in real work.

  • Time series modelling. You have modelled temporal data where autocorrelation, drift, or seasonality mattered.

  • Python. The stack the team uses.

The salary

We expect to pay from £90,000 – £120,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

About the Role

You'll own a significant slice of the SINGU product suite: space management and Soft FM services – cleaning standards, portering, and catering – used every day primarily across the UK healthcare market. Product-market fit is established and thousands of users depend on these products daily. What the portfolio needs now is strategic direction and taking them to their next level of growth.

You'll do that through a team of four Product Managers who are domain experts in the products they run. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll stay close to customer problems yourself, you'll raise the bar on how the team discovers and validates work, and you'll have real autonomy to decide what's worth building – and to prove it works.

SINGU group grows both organically and through acquisition, and several of these products arrived with the companies that built them. You'll shape the strategy for bringing them into one coherent ecosystem and lead your team through that change. If you enjoy taking a set of good but separate products and making them add up to something bigger, that is the interesting part of this job.

You'll partner closely with Sales, Engineering, and Product colleagues across the SINGU Group so your portfolio drives revenue and solves real problems across the European FM market. AI is a must-have lever in our industry rather than a talking point: you'll be applying it where it measurably improves how our customers run their estates.

This is a remote position with periodic travel to London and Kraków – roughly every two to four weeks.

Role Scope

  • Manage and develop the Product Managers within the product team.

  • Own the full management lifecycle: hiring, onboarding, mentorship, feedback, coaching, performance evaluations, promotions, and exits.

  • Foster a high-performing product culture based on customer empathy, data-driven decision-making, and outcome orientation.

  • Manage staffing and focus areas across the suite, reallocating product resources where needed to balance discovery workload and meet strategic priorities.

  • Represent the company at external events, conferences, and industry forums to share product insights, build the Group's profile, and stay connected to market trends.

Experience & Requirements

Must have's:

  • 5+ years in product management, ideally with at least three of them in B2B SaaS. Strong B2C experience in FM, healthcare, or an adjacent domain is also worth a conversation.

Nice to Have's:

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About MUBI

MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision.

That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere.

About the role

This is a senior, hands-on product role for someone who wants to own a meaningful slice of the MUBI product end-to-end, and is at their best when the problem is still ambiguous.

You’ll own the Audience & Platform Expansion domain - a critical product surface for our next phase of growth. In this role, you will be responsible for building the scalable foundation to drive global subscriber acquisition and pioneer our tiered premium offerings. You’ll own its strategy, its roadmap and its delivery, from a high-level business goal all the way to a shipped, measured feature. The hardest product problems at MUBI cross team and time-zone boundaries, and break down without someone holding the whole picture; this role exists to be that person for one of these domains.

Reporting to our Senior Product Director, this is a senior, individual contributor role. You'll lead through clarity and influence rather than headcount - aligning engineering, design and data scientists around a vision they actually believe in, and mentoring/coaching other, more junior PMs as you go. We care about craft, in the films we champion and in the products we build, so the bar is product excellence and real user impact, not shipping for its own sake.

We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 office days in Soho, London (if you're in commutable distance from London). Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish.

Where you'll have impact

You'll own a product surface that leadership relies on, translating ambiguous, evolving priorities into a roadmap teams can execute against - and giving the business a crisp, honest read on what's working, what isn't, and what needs a decision. As you build credibility through delivery, you'll set the standard for how product strategy is articulated and defended at MUBI. Concretely, you'll:

  • Translate business goals into clear, actionable product roadmaps, and own the sub-strategy for a specific MUBI area (e.g. onboarding, content/catalogue discovery, monetization, or viewer experience).

  • Guide technical products through the entire lifecycle - from conception, through development, into launch - and iterate after.

  • Partner directly with Engineering, UX/UI Design, Data Science, Marketing, Business Development and Legal to define product requirements and resolve trade-offs.

  • Establish the KPIs and OKRs for your area, and use data-backed insight to iterate quickly and demonstrate measurable impact.

  • Pitch roadmaps to senior leadership to guide resource allocation, and align engineering, design and analytics teams without relying on direct hierarchy.

  • Write narrative strategy memos and present complex visions clearly - to senior leadership and engineering teams alike.

  • Mentor other team members and raise the bar for product thinking around you.

What you'll bring

  • You've spent significant time shipping complex technical products end to end, and you're happiest owning a problem from the messy, ambiguous start rather than picking up a tidy backlog. You bring structure where there is none - a clear strategy, sharp prioritisation, honest measurement - without becoming a source of process for its own sake.

  • You're technically fluent enough to hold your own with strong engineers: you can translate an ML model, a streaming architecture or a latency constraint into a business trade-off a stakeholder can act on, and tell a real architectural limit from a convenient one.

  • You're an excellent communicator who can flex between an engineer and an executive in the same hour, equally comfortable writing a strategy memo and defending it in a leadership review.

  • You lead through influence - aligning people across functions, regions and time zones around work they want to do.

Qualifications & Expectations

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Design, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years in product management or a closely related technical role, with at least 3–5 years focused on shipping complex technical products from 0 to 1.

  • Strong business judgment and strategic thinking - able to see the big picture and make connections across teams and issues.

  • Technical acumen: the ability to translate highly technical engineering constraints (machine learning models, streaming architectures, latency) into clear business trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Deep domain fluency in identity and access management, subscription management, billing and monetization, and data processing - with the ability to debate architectural and technical trade-offs.

  • A proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through influence rather than direct authority.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including narrative strategy writing for senior audiences.

  • Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Experience with AI tools, and AI prototyping

  • A deep alignment with MUBI's culture and values: craftsmanship, product excellence, a bias toward high-impact work, and genuine respect for the user.

We want to make cinema accessible to everyone. We believe people from different backgrounds bring different ideas that foster innovation and engagement, allowing us to attract great people to develop the best experience for our users.

MUBI is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer. That means it's our responsibility to ensure that all candidates are not discriminated against in our hiring processes and our employment decisions based on their race, color, religion, nationality or ethnic origin, age, gender identity or expression, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, socioeconomic background, sexual orientation, family or parental status, or any other applicable characteristic.

title: Senior Manager, Solution Engineering EMEA
description:
At Sanity.io, we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like SKIMS, Figma, Riot Games, Anthropic, COMPLEX, Nordstrom, and Morningbrew are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

In this role you'll own EMEA as your region: full remit over the Solution Engineering team's success, working as a player-coach who hires, develops, and holds the bar on how the team runs discovery, demos, and evaluations, while getting hands-on in the highest-impact deals across the region. You'll own execution of Sanity's core presales motions — discovery, tailored demos, POVs, and architecture/security reviews — coaching SEs to run them with consistency and to connect Sanity's value drivers to real business outcomes, not just features or functionality.

You'll partner closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing across EMEA, reporting into and collaborating with the Sr. Director of Solution Engineering on strategy and priorities. You'll also make sure your team is set up to win with the presales toolkit — demo environments, collateral, evaluation guides — iterating and building where you see gaps for your region.

We care about the impact we make for our customers, and we show up as a consultative partner in every interaction to support their success. If this is how you operate, this role is for you.

What you would do

  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of Solution Engineers across EMEA — hiring, ramping, and running regular 1:1s and deal reviews.

  • Get hands-on in the team’s highest-impact opportunities, from discovery through close, modelling the behaviours you want your team to run.

  • Execute and reinforce Sanity’s established presales motions (discovery, demos, POVs, architecture/security reviews) with consistency across the team, rather than defining new ones.

  • Coach SEs to translate technical capability into business outcomes for developers, architects, product leaders, and content teams.

  • Evangelise and drive consistent use of AI tools — for call prep, faster POC/demo environment setup, and turning discovery notes into follow-up docs — to cut cycle time without sacrificing quality.

  • Own regional forecasting and pipeline hygiene for presales involvement, and report on team performance and technical win rates.

  • Partner with Sales leadership, Product, and Marketing in EMEA, and route field feedback up to the Sr. Director of Solution Engineering.

  • Make sure your team is set up to win with the presales toolkit — demo environments, collateral, evaluation guides — iterating and building where you see gaps for your region.

About you:

  • Experience managing or leading a Solutions Engineering / Presales team in B2B SaaS, ideally selling highly technical, composable, headless, or API-first platforms — CMS, DXP, or adjacent tools in the modern content stack..

  • Strong technical foundation: comfortable discussing APIs, data models, front-end frameworks, integrations, and modern architecture patterns.

  • Track record of improving team performance through coaching, hands-on deal support, and consistent execution of an established presales process.

  • Clear, inclusive communicator who can flex from deep technical detail to executive-level value narratives.

  • Experience selling developer-facing, composable, or API-first SaaS platforms — content management, digital experience, or similar tooling in the modern content stack.

  • Familiarity with content workflows, editorial tooling, or digital experience stacks.

  • Collaborative leadership style with high integrity and a bias toward developing others.

  • Fluent with AI-based tools across your technical work — evaluations, architecture conversations, research, day-to-day productivity — and able to bring that fluency to how the team operates.

Not sure you’re exactly what we’re looking for in this role? Apply anyway!

What we can offer:

  • A highly-skilled, inspiring, and supportive team.

  • Positive, flexible, and trust-based work environment that encourages long-term professional and personal growth.

  • A global, multi-culturally diverse group of colleagues and customers.

  • Comprehensive health plans and perks.

  • A healthy work-life balance that accommodates individual and family needs.

  • Competitive salary and stock options program.

Who we are:

Sanity.io is a modern, flexible content operating system that replaces rigid legacy content management systems. One of our big differentiators is treating content as data so that it can be stored in a single source of truth, but seamlessly adapted and personalized for any channel without extra effort. Forward-thinking companies choose Sanity because they can create tailored content authoring experiences, customized workflows, and content models that reflect their business.

Sanity recently raised a $85m Series C led by GP Bullhound and is also backed by leading investors like ICONIQ Growth, Threshold Ventures, Heavybit and Shopify, as well as founders of companies like Vercel, WPEngine, Twitter, Mux, Netlify and Heroku. This funding round has put Sanity in a strong position for accelerated growth in the coming years.

You can only build a great company with a great culture. Sanity is a 200+ person company with highly committed and ambitious people. We are pioneers, we exist for our customers, we are hel ved, and we love type two fun! Read more about our values here!

Sanity.io pledges to be an organization that reflects the globally diverse audience that our product serves. We believe that in addition to hiring the best talent, a diversity of perspectives, ideas, and cultures leads to the creation of better products and services. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

title: Talent Acquisition- Maternity Cover
description:
Talent Acquisition Recruiter – Maternity Cover

London | Full time | 4 days in the office + 1 day from home | Approx. 12 months

At Inditex, recruitment is about much more than filling vacancies.

It’s about connecting with people, spotting potential, understanding our brands and helping candidates find their path with us.

We’re looking for an energetic, creative and proactive Recruiter to join our London Talent Acquisition team and support recruitment across our retail management population in the UK and Ireland.

You’ll need to trust your eye for talent, know how to engage people from the very first conversation and enjoy accompanying candidates through their journey with us — from first contact to contract.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own end-to-end recruitment for retail management positions across the UK and Ireland.

  • Proactively identify and connect with talent through LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, Recruitee and new sourcing channels you bring to the table.

  • Build relationships with candidates and guide them through their recruitment journey, making sure every interaction feels engaging, personal and transparent.

  • Partner closely with HR Managers and Area Managers, understanding their teams, their stores and the talent they need.

  • Run one-to-one interviews, group interviews, Recruitment Days and Branding events.

  • Visit stores, markets and events to stay connected to what is happening in retail and where the best talent is.

  • Build strong talent pipelines before the vacancy even exists.

  • Get involved in creative Talent Acquisition projects — from recruitment partnerships and employer branding to talent strategy, corporate projects and digital initiatives.

  • Constantly look for better ways to recruit. If one route doesn’t work, you find another.

Who we’re looking for

You probably have around 2–3 years of recruitment experience within retail and a strong understanding of the UK market.

You’ll also be someone who:

  • Has strong experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and genuinely enjoys proactive sourcing.

  • Knows how to connect with candidates and turn a first conversation into real interest.

  • Has a strong eye for talent and is confident assessing potential, not just matching CVs to job descriptions.

  • Understands fashion and retail and is curious about brands, competitors and the market.

  • Brings energy, personality and strong communication skills.

  • Is confident working with demanding stakeholders and comfortable challenging when needed.

  • Thinks outside the box and doesn’t accept “there are no candidates” as the final answer.

  • Takes ownership, works autonomously and brings ideas rather than waiting for direction.

  • Is organised enough to manage multiple recruitment processes, stakeholders and projects at the same time.

Experience with Recruitee, Indeed or similar recruitment platforms is a plus.

If you love fashion, people and the challenge of finding the right talent — and you want a role where your ideas can genuinely shape how we recruit — we’d love to meet you.

title: Data Analyst (Credit)
description:

Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need loads more people to help us make our vision a reality.

This could not be a better time to join Octopus Energy. We are already recognised as a global leader in the fight to decarbonise the planet by revolutionising what’s possible in energy - including investments in renewable energy supply, renewable energy generation, smart energy networks, EVs, heat pumps, etc. The government's new green initiatives and the recent investment by Al Gore’s Generation Fund will propel us further and faster.

There has never been a more important moment to join our credit risk team. The energy sector is going through a period of once-in-a-generation volatility. Businesses and households are facing higher energy prices than they ever have before. For these reasons we are looking to add to our credit risk team with this new role. This team sits at the heart of everything we do to support customers that are struggling with their bills. We’re unique because we are genuinely a hybrid of a few different skills and mindsets:
